About

Mangalam Cement Limited, part of the
B.K. Birla Group is a North and Central
India-focused cement manufacturer
selling under the Birla Uttam and
Mangalam ProMaxX brands. It
operates an integrated cement
complex at Morak, Rajasthan,
a grinding unit at Aligarh, Uttar
Pradesh, and a small MDF-board
division at Nabarangpur, Odisha.

Key Points

Product Profile:[1]
The company sells regular OPC, PPC cements and clinker under the brand Birla Uttam.
